# ContextMenu

The right-click, long-press or Shift+F10 menu on graph nodes, edges, the empty canvas and table rows, using the same look and keyboard model as OverflowMenu.

`SongNodes.ContextMenu` · Navigation

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.ContextMenu target={…} position={…} actions={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.ContextMenu" target="{{…}}" position="{{…}}" actions="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (ContextMenuProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `target` * | `{ kind; title: string; subtitle?: string }` | What was right-clicked, long-pressed or Shift+F10'd. |
| `position` * | `{ x: number; y: number }` | Viewport position to open at (clamped inside the screen). |
| `actions` * | `MenuAction[]` | Items for this target (see README for the standard sets). |
| `onSelect` * | `(id: string) => void` | Called with the chosen id. |
| `onClose` * | `() => void` | Called on Esc, outside click or Tab; focus returns to the target. |

### MenuAction

One action shown in an OverflowMenu or ContextMenu.

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` * | `string` | Stable id passed back to onSelect. |
| `label` * | `string` | Verb-first label in sentence case, e.g. "Export as CSV". |
| `icon` | `string` | Lucide icon name from assets/Icons. |
| `shortcut` | `string` | Shortcut hint shown as a key cap, e.g. "F". |
| `disabledReason` | `string` | When set the item is aria-disabled and this reason is shown under the label. |
| `destructive` | `boolean` | Destructive: status-bad text, placed last after a separator; label ends with "…". |
| `checked` | `boolean` | Makes it a menuitemcheckbox with this checked state. |
| `group` | `string` | Group heading this item sits under, e.g. "Route". |
